## accounts

A login account. Replaces the BBS
user record; the character's kept userid column equals the username at import.

| Column | SQLite | PostgreSQL | Key | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | BIGSERIAL | PK | account id |
| `username` | TEXT | TEXT |  | login name, unique case-insensitive |
| `password_hash` | TEXT | TEXT |  | argon2id PHC string, '' until set |
| `email` | TEXT | TEXT | nullable | optional contact address |
| `created` | TEXT | TEXT |  | RFC 3339 UTC |
| `last_login` | TEXT | TEXT | nullable | RFC 3339 UTC, NULL before the first login |
| `flags` | INTEGER | BIGINT |  | bit 0 sex (0 M, 1 F); bits 1-3 no_gossip, no_auction, no_loan |

Indexes:

- `accounts_username` unique on `(username)` (PostgreSQL: `(lower(username))`)

## text_blocks

Text-block record, WCCTEXT: one part of a text block. text is stored
decoded (the record adds 0x20 to every byte; the importer subtracts it). A block is
parts 0, 1, 2.. of one number read in order;
link is another block number for callers that chain texts.

| Column | SQLite | PostgreSQL | Key | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | BIGSERIAL | PK | surrogate key |
| `part` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | continuation number, 0 first (key 0 part 1) |
| `number` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | text block number (key 0 part 2) |
| `link` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | linked text block number, 0 none |
| `text` | TEXT | TEXT |  | the text, decoded |

Indexes:

- `text_blocks_part_number` unique on `(part, number)`
- `text_blocks_number` index on `(number, part)`

| `firstname` | TEXT | TEXT |  | player.firstname |
| `lastname` | TEXT | TEXT |  | player.lastname |
| `flags` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | player.flags |
| `statfmt` | TEXT | TEXT |  | custom statline template |
| `gossmax` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | player.gossmax |
| `auctmax` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | player.auctmax |
| `daybyte` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | the day of the counts, same day only |
| `expbil` | INTEGER | BIGINT |  | kept experience, billions |
| `exprem` | INTEGER | BIGINT |  | kept experience, remainder |

## evil_points

Evil-points record, genbb "WCC MAJOR MUD EVIL": evil points kept over a
death, one per account.

| Column | SQLite | PostgreSQL | Key | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | INTEGER | BIGINT | PK, → accounts.id | the account |
| `userid` | TEXT | TEXT |  | user-id (key part 1), kept |
| `evil` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | evil points |

## bank_books

Bank-book record, WCCBANKS: key 0 is (userid, bank).

| Column | SQLite | PostgreSQL | Key | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | BIGSERIAL | PK | surrogate key |
| `account_id` | INTEGER | BIGINT | → accounts.id | the owner |
| `userid` | TEXT | TEXT |  | owner's user-id, kept |
| `bank` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | the bank's shop number |
| `balance` | INTEGER | BIGINT |  | money on deposit |
| `loan` | INTEGER | BIGINT |  | money owed |

Indexes:

- `bank_books_account_bank` unique on `(account_id, bank)`

## gangs

Gang record, WCCGANGS.

| Column | SQLite | PostgreSQL | Key | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | BIGSERIAL | PK | surrogate key |
| `key` | TEXT | TEXT |  | name in upper case, key 0, unique case-insensitive |
| `name` | TEXT | TEXT |  | name as entered |
| `exp` | INTEGER | BIGINT |  | gang experience, key 1 |
| `leader` | TEXT | TEXT |  | leader's character name |
| `created` | INTEGER | BIGINT |  | date founded, Unix seconds UTC |
| `members` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | number of members |
| `flags` | INTEGER | BIGINT |  | GF_* bits |
| `overexp` | INTEGER | BIGINT |  | experience past the cap |
| `overflows` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | extra wraps of overexp |

Indexes:

- `gangs_key` unique on `(key)` (PostgreSQL: `(lower(key))`)
- `gangs_exp` index on `(exp DESC)`

## item_ownership

Item-ownership record, WCCITOWN: where one copy of a limited item is.

| Column | SQLite | PostgreSQL | Key | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | INTEGER | PK | record id, key 0 |
| `itemnum` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | item number, key 1 part 1 |
| `owntype` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | OWN_* code, key 1 part 2 |
| `mapnum` | INTEGER | BIGINT |  | OWN_ROOM: map |
| `roomnum` | INTEGER | BIGINT |  | OWN_ROOM: room |
| `userid` | TEXT | TEXT |  | OWN_USER: user-id |
| `monnum` | INTEGER | INTEGER |  | OWN_MONSTER: active monster |

Indexes:

- `item_ownership_item` index on `(itemnum, owntype)`

## events

Append-only game events; the
shocst call sites write here as well as to tracing. Pruned to a retention count.

| Column | SQLite | PostgreSQL | Key | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | BIGSERIAL | PK | event id, ascending in time |
| `at` | TEXT | TEXT |  | RFC 3339 UTC |
| `kind` | TEXT | TEXT |  | event kind, e.g. login, death, level |
| `session` | INTEGER | INTEGER | nullable | session id, NULL for world events |
| `character` | INTEGER | BIGINT | nullable | character id, NULL when none |
| `map` | INTEGER | BIGINT | nullable | map of the room concerned, NULL when none |
| `room` | INTEGER | BIGINT | nullable | room concerned, NULL when none |
| `payload` | TEXT | TEXT |  | JSON object with the event's details |

Indexes:

- `events_kind` index on `(kind, id)`

## world_import

One row: `silvermere import` writes started_at (and clears finished_at) before its first
table and finished_at after its last, so a start can tell a world an import left half
written from a whole one. No row: never imported by this version (a test's seeded world).

| Column | SQLite | PostgreSQL | Key | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | INTEGER | PK | always 1 |
| `started_at` | TEXT | TEXT |  | RFC 3339 UTC, when the last import began writing |
| `finished_at` | TEXT | TEXT | nullable | RFC 3339 UTC, when it finished; NULL while it writes or after it was cut off |
